section: When Was the Last time You Saw 2

conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: When was the last time you saw Xiyuan’s father? Do you two talk often?
Respondent: What about Xiyuan’s father? What does Xiyuan’s disappearance have to do with him?
Respondent: Xiyuan’s father hasn’t been in contact with us for a long time.
Respondent: Ever since the child became like that.
Respondent: Ah... no...
Respondent: I mean, when Xiyuan was seriously ill as a child, he just abandoned her and divorced my daughter. How could he be so heartless?
Respondent: But he definitely wouldn’t secretly take the child away. He’s not that kind of person.
Respondent: Don’t make random suspicions... Nothing will happen.
